verdict.rationale: Figma's Variables REST API and MCP docs confirm designers/teams can create, query, and sync variables (colors, spacing, typography) as a design-system source of truth, and Code Connect ties tokens to code — but no evidence explicitly documents mode/theme switching (e.g., light/dark mode variable collections) or independent hands-on confirmation of that workflow. missing for 10: explicit documentation of variable modes/themes, hands-on/community corroboration of multi-mode theming in practice.
